Hello,
I just want to give my opinion on this maps :


1 - This map is amazing, cool and I like the music.


2 - unknown map for me but I saw this map crashing some servers in some version but maybe it's fixed.


3 - This map is good and hard but I'm bad on course map.


4 - unknown map for me.


5 - Good map with beautiful graphics but some obstacles are hard as fuck.


6 - I like to play this map because this map is really fun but I don't know if this map should be on a minigamea server.


Anyway, I would like to see those maps on the server.


Thanks for reading.

Hey,


first of all thank you guys for hitting me back on that post.
You're right Luckiris, maps could cause a server crash, but i've seen them all on different servers and they always worked, however if they do crash the server i'm sorry [^^]


Like your comments and i agree :).


Have some wonderful christmas days,


~ <<

Thanks for the suggestions, @Hypnoxas and I tested the maps and this came out of it:


  • mg_wl_multigames_csgo_v1

    • We used to have it on the server but it was buggy and it even says so on the workshop page. Therefore we removed the map
  • mg_runordie:

    • Not a fun enough map
  • mg_last_light:

    • Was added to the server
  • mg_spongebob_defense:

    • Weird map, was not fun during playtesting
  • mg_kohztec_course:

    • Looks great but has some parts that are too difficult and some parts that are hard to figure out, so we decided to not add it
  • de_rats_1337:

    • Looks fun, but is not a minigames map, so it won't be added.
